node.title: A=1 constant-residual triple-tangency packets
node.closure: local cube valuation and exact defect allocation
node.statement: Away from the roots of the small residual X-form, the ambient cube identity makes every heavy supported horizontal intersection a positive multiple of three, so it consumes at least two specialized excess-recurrence degrees. The core-free residual-degree-two case consequently has exactly two distinguished heavy rows with deficits {1,1} or {1,2} and at most one ordinary heavy incidence. The core-one residual-degree-one case has one distinguished heavy row of deficit 2..6 and at most two ordinary heavy incidences, in six exact gap packets.
